blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan may just voluntarily leave the Philippines, and not wait to be declared persona non grata, according to Sen. Erwin Tulfo. Tulfo made the suggestion as he and colleagues in the majority plan to file a measure, declaring Jing persona non grata over his remarks that China could easily win against the Philippines if they would use force.
